status: Sensor acquisition and native cooling paths traced; Android CPU/GPU policy coordination review remains in progress.
address_convention: Ghidra virtual addresses in the explicitly selected ARM64 v8A program.

native_policy.decision: Retain the native controller and calibration. No raised thresholds or disabled throttling are introduced.

thermal_core.physical: get_tz_temp 0x111220 reads thermal_zoneN/temp as integer values.
thermal_core.virtual: get_virtual_tz_temp 0x110fc0 supports maximum or weighted-sum computation with a gate sensor and hysteresis; unresolved dependency returns -274000.
thermal_core.output: Reserved virtual indices may publish U_VSENSOR records to /sys/kernel/thermal/user_vsensor; this is distinct from Honor shell caches.

dubaid.discovery: HnThermalUtils::FindThermalZone 0x386b6c matches type names case-sensitively, selects the first match and resolves its temp path.
dubaid.raw_read: RealSensor::DefaultSensorUpdateValue 0x38e050 reads an integer without scaling and tracks read/fd failures.
dubaid.conversion: ReportTemperature::UpdateSensorTemperature 0x388994 applies the configured operation; division by 1000 stores truncated whole Celsius and a milli-Celsius remainder with CLOCK_BOOTTIME timestamps.
dubaid.distinction: Reporter filtering, shell estimation and Android HAL severity are separate stages, not interchangeable readings.

lineage.unit: milli-Celsius before the stock estimator/reporter conversions
lineage.discovery_fix: A shared complete-scan routine now rejects unreadable, empty or truncated type files and directory failures before declaring uniqueness or sensor absence. Duplicate type names remain explicit; callers reject ambiguous required sources.
lineage.difference_from_stock: The port deliberately rejects ambiguous discovery instead of selecting the first matching stock zone.

threshold_callback.state: Enable is latched only when the callback returns 1; release clears the latch.

general_cooler.behavior: Resolve configured cooling name and write its computed limit to cooling_deviceN/cur_state.

catm.behavior: Calculate proportional/integral terms with retained state, direction-dependent gain and configured clamps.

targets.behavior: Suppress unchanged targets; apply independent target caps unless bypassed. Publish CPU/GPU/NPU threshold notifications in Celsius for non-sentinel targets.

hint_coordination.owner: Native perf_lock_acq/perf_lock_rel handle; separate from UniPerf clients 1 and 2.
hint_coordination.release: Native releases and clears its stored handle on the traced disable/release path.

android_thermal_hal.conversion: Maximum configured raw sample multiplied by 0.001 into Celsius.
android_thermal_hal.missing_sample: The accumulator starts at -274000; the valid-type return flag does not prove a successful sensor sample.
android_thermal_hal.cooling_inventory: fill_cooling_devices 0x112390 discovers cooling_deviceN/type and cur_state; reporting a cooling device is distinct from deciding its limit.
android_thermal_hal.warning: Do not substitute Android SKIN severity for the Honor shell_back display policy.

android_policy.level_engine: Stock K0 converts XML thresholds and clear thresholds by 1000; warm enter >=, clear <=. The Lineage StockThermalLevelEngine retains this boundary behavior.

soc_policy.coordination: Separate current/previous maps support residual release followed by changed policy application. Additional paths cover core isolation, CATM, refresh rate and scene-specific hints.
soc_policy.port_gate: Every field must be matched to the retained MediaTek adapter. Some stock GPU leaves contain legacy frequency-like values, whereas tag 10 expects a level index; copying the XML value is not a qualified GPU limit.

android_policy.lineage: Display scene selection, reporter epochs, level hysteresis and seven display controls are already present. The CPU/GPU thermal-policy adapter review is still open.

validation.hardware_effect: Not tested in this offline phase.

remaining: Finish native CATM/threshold configuration-field and cooling-owner reconciliation.
Qualify Honor CPU/GPU leaf dispatch, release values and mode predicates against this MTK adapter.
Review display/power cross-policy failures and add any evidence-backed missing integration.
Run focused component checks and final completion audit.
